label: Rhacodactylus leachianus
notes: Real-species positive control (New Caledonia giant gecko): a vertebrate the 12SV5 primers amplify but which never occurs in human diet samples. Genuinely spiked in production (1.05M reads across 45 samples of the 2025 megaphyloseq). Present in every reference up to 2025 via inherited broad databases; must be added explicitly now that the pipeline builds only from human-foods.csv. Amplicon and lineage taken from the 2025 reference record. lineage column: semicolon-separated superkingdom->forma; leave empty for synthetic constructs (label is then repeated across ranks).
